product_one_liner.value: Fluxco helps utilities, developers, EPCs, and other energy and industrial buyers specify and source transformers through competitive bids from its global OEM network, then manages procurement through delivery and warranty.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer/navigation has no pricing link; the pricing search did not surface a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The closest customer reference names only Antora Energy; no second customer name is supported there.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 13 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

founded_year.notes: Multiple company profiles identify 2025 as the founding year; some directories disagree, so confidence is medium.

eng_blog.notes: The public index consists of buyer guides, transformer technical resources, and industry insights, not posts by engineers about how Fluxco builds its product.

public_docs.notes: The homepage links an FAQ but no product documentation or developer portal; the FAQ is a single general-information page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The AI-Native Generalist opening is a full-stack web-platform role that uses AI coding tools; the posted responsibilities are web, database, and marketplace engineering rather than AI/ML or data-science work.

model_provider.notes: Fluxco describes AI-assisted work and generic AI service providers in its public materials, but does not name the model or provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: Fluxco has a public legal/privacy page, but it does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 Seed round falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers page lists an Account Executive (Data Centers) opening with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: A dated August 2026 company profile reports Fluxco’s launch of its Global Transformer Network, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Tochman is listed as Fluxco Founder and CEO with a January 2026 start date, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting refers generically to keeping the CRM clean but does not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
